notes: No operative institutional delegations exist in this bootstrap record. Technical repository permissions are not delegations. An operative delegation must identify a unique delegation_id, holder_person_id, a structured source authority resolving to the adopted decision that creates the delegation, exact scope types and resources, allowed actions, explicit prohibitions, governing rule version, effective/expiry dates, revocation contract and a content-addressed decision record. Maturity gates count only delegations actually effective and unexpired on the target phase-effective date.
